title: A Long-term Follow-up Study of Patients with MPS IIIA from Gene Therapy Clinical Trials Involving the Administration of ABO-102 (scAAV9.U1a.hSGSH)
official: A Long-term Follow-up Study of Patients with MPS IIIA from Gene Therapy Clinical Trials Involving the Administration of ABO-102 (scAAV9.U1a.hSGSH)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety/tolerability of UX111 in patients with MPS IIIA
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants that have participated in a prior clinical trial in which they received UX111
2. Parent(s)/legal guardian(s) of participant willing and able to complete the informed consent process and comply with study procedures and visit schedule.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Planned or current participation in another clinical trial that may confound the safety or efficacy evaluation of UX111 during this study
2. Any other situation or medical condition that precludes the participant from undergoing procedures required in this study.
